pre_execution.description: Verify Python runtime, virtual environment, and core tool binaries
Ensure workspace state is known and snapshot baseline Git commit SHA
Verify tool permissions and required environment variables for the skill

post_execution.description: Run AST syntax check on any modified Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and JSON files
Run repository unit tests to ensure no regressions were introduced

on_failure.description: Evaluate retry budget, check error fingerprint to avoid loops, and optionally rollback
